explication: Sylius is a Symfony-based eCommerce framework. Its principal user journey is shopping through the storefront, progressing from product discovery and cart management through checkout to an order; administrators manage the catalog and commerce configuration, while the REST API supports integrations. The tree also shows review submission, channel-aware currency and cart-session services, and interchangeable state-machine adapters. Most commerce subsystems are represented by their existing directories because their implementation was not sampled; the graph avoids inferring internal calls between them.
